name: Lina Gálvez - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 69th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text:
The European Parliament is telling the Council what the EU should push for at a United Nations meeting on women's rights in March 2025. It asks the EU to defend the 1995 Beijing Declaration on women's rights, fight back against growing opposition to gender equality, protect access to abortion and sexual and reproductive health care, support women's groups, and make gender equality part of all EU policies, including money spent abroad. The report is the Parliament's advice; it does not change any law by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is advice to the Council, which negotiates for the EU at the UN meeting.
- **Who it affects:** EU negotiators, women and girls, and women's rights groups the EU funds.
- **What happens next:** The Council decides the EU position for the March 2025 meeting in New York.
